description: This Java source file defines the SettingsForm class, which is a graphical user interface (GUI) window for configuring application settings in the RomRaider project. It provides tabs for general settings, table display preferences, clipboard formats, icon scaling, and scale options, with various controls like checkboxes, radio buttons, color choosers, and text fields. The class handles user interactions such as opening color pickers, applying or saving settings, restoring defaults, and managing file associations. It interacts with the Settings manager to load and save configuration data, and communicates with the main editor to refresh UI elements based on the updated settings.

classes.name: SettingsForm
classes.description: A JFrame-based GUI for modifying application settings, including UI preferences, table display options, clipboard formats, icon scales, and file associations.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Handles mouse click events for color labels to open color choosers, and for buttons to apply, save, reset settings, or manage file associations.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Reads the current state of the GUI controls and updates the Settings object accordingly, including font, colors, scales, and formats.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Persists the current Settings object to storage, updates open tables, and refreshes the editor UI.
